interpretation: The Nyāsa distinguishes the suffix accent of the stellar and possessive derivational accounts. In these transmitted texts stellar revátī at AVŚ 19.7.5c has the same written accent as the two Ṛgvedic nominative singulars of possessive revánt-. A transmitted token and a specific grammatical analysis are kept separate. The red-cow/flame stem and the AVŚ asterism both have initial accent in these witnesses.
lexical_controls: Monier-Williams permits a final accent for the Rohiṇī asterism alongside its dictionary head with initial accent. This is a lexical report, distinct from the single actual accent in AVŚ 19.7.2a. Apte also lists a red cow and the asterism at its one head.
previous_positions: Reuse the unaccented ī-declensions from PG212 only to compare form at the same case and number. None of the three red-entity tokens is assigned the stellar sense. Six Ṛgvedic long-ī plural tokens have a different nominative/vocative ending from the ordinary table.
